visualCharacteristics: Two equal image tiles with background photo and large title; label box with CTA bottom-left; list of quick links per audience revealed on hover/focus (always visible on touch and mobile).
contentPattern: One row per tile. Cell 1: background picture. Cell 2: H2 title, bullet list of links, CTA link paragraph.
usage: Home page 'Para sua casa' / 'Para sua empresa' audience entry tiles.
reuseGuidance: Use for a small set of audience/segment entry tiles each with a photo, a title, a list of quick links and one CTA. Quick links are optional.
